name: By appointment,
description: By appointment, is a family-run pumpkin patch in Auburn, CA. It grows Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, Boysenberries, and Persimmons, with picking through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
